heroHeadline: US-Mediated Russia-Ukraine Talks Resume in Abu Dhabi After Nine Months
heroSubtitle: Delegations led by Umerov and Medinsky met Nov 10-11 with Witkoff and Kushner mediating, focused on security guarantees; no outcome of day two was reported. Overnight Nov 11, Russia reported 146 drones downed over Leningrad region.
